jobs.title: Data Center Engineer – Operations
jobs.description:
Om Conapto Conapto är en svensk datacenter-operatör med fyra datacenter och huvudkontor i Stockholm. Vi erbjuder säker och hållbar colocation för företag med höga krav på prestanda och tillgänglighet, och skapar lösningar som möter behoven hos allt från avancerade IT-miljöer till high performance computing och den snabbt växande utvecklingen inom artificiell intelligens (AI). Conapto verkar i en snabbväxande bransch och befinner sig i en expansiv fas med fortsatt utveckling av vår kapacitet i Stockholmsregionen. Som operatörsneutral aktör erbjuder vi våra kunder flexibla och framtidssäkra lösningar för deras digitala infrastruktur.
  
  
Hållbarhet är en integrerad del av vår verksamhet. Våra datacenter drivs med 100 % förnybar el och överskottsvärme återvinns till lokala fjärrvärmenät i samarbete med Stockholm Exergi och Sollentuna Energi & Miljö. Vi bidrar även till stabiliteten i det svenska elnätet genom balanstjänster. Kundupplevelsen står i centrum och Conapto har idag ett Net Promoter Score (NPS) på +85, vilket speglar det starka förtroende som kunderna har för Conapto.
  
  
Sedan 2021 ägs Conapto av den europeiska infrastrukturfonden Marguerite. Conapto bildades 2018 genom förvärvet av Sungard Availability Services svenska verksamhet, med en historia inom datacenterbranschen som sträcker sig tillbaka till 1982. Vi söker nu en Data Center Engineer inom Operations Vill du arbeta med kritisk infrastruktur i en modern och växande verksamhet? Conapto söker nu en Data Center Engineer inom Operations till vårt norra datacenter campus i Sollentuna.
  
  
Här får du en central roll i den dagliga driften och utvecklingen av vår datacenterverksamhet, med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka. Om rollen Som Data Center Engineer blir du en viktig del av Operations teamet och ansvarar för att säkerställa en stabil, säker och högkvalitativ drift av vår kritiska infrastruktur. Rollen är praktisk och teknisk, med en kombination av kundkontakt, installationer, felsökning och löpande underhåll. Du arbetar nära både kunder och kollegor och behöver därför vara trygg i din tekniska kompetens, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad.
  
  
Du får ett stort eget ansvar och förväntas ta initiativ, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och bidra till att utveckla våra arbetssätt. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att vara: Planera och genomföra kundinstallationer i datacentret Ansvar för installation och inmätning av fiber/kommunikationsinfrastruktur Utföra felsökning och incidenthantering i dialog med kunder Genomföra regelbundna inspektioner och ronder Installera och konfigurera hårdvara i datahallsmiljö Underhåll av kritisk infrastruktur Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av drift, processer och arbetssätt Om dig: Vi söker dig som har god erfarenhet av drift och underhåll i en kritisk verksamhet och som trivs med att arbeta praktiskt och tekniskt. Du är van vid att arbeta strukturerat och noggrant, även i situationer där det ställs höga krav på kvalitet och säkerhet. Minst 8 års erfarenhet av drift och underhåll i kritisk verksamhet Teknisk kompentens inom fiber- och kopparnätverk God erfarenhet av installationsarbete av hårdvara inom datahallsmiljö Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift B-körkort Mer om dig: Som person ser vi att du är noggrann, strukturerad och trivs med att jobba i team.
  
  
Du gillar att ta del av ny kunskap, utmana gamla sanningar och dela med dig av din erfarenhet. Du har ett starkt kundfokus och levererar högkvalitativ service med förstklassigt bemötande är viktigt för dig. Beredskap ingår i tjänsten. Conaptos erbjudande Conapto är en utmanare i branschen som växer snabbt och har mycket nöjda och intressanta kunder.
  
  
Du får bidra till en verksamhet som befinner sig i en spännande tillväxtfas. Samtidigt blir du en del i en unik arbetskultur som präglas av självledarskap, delaktighet och frihet under ansvar. Hos Conapto får du dessutom vara med och bidra till en mer hållbar värld genom att möjliggöra den digitala infrastruktur som krävs för framtidens samhälle. Ansökan I denna rekrytering samarbetar Conapto med Active Search.
  
  
För mer information kontakta gärna rekryteringskonsult Fanni Orestav på telefon: 073 – 852 79 63 eller via mejl: fanni@active-search.se För att du som kandidat skall få bästa möjliga kandidatupplevelse, ber vi dig ödmjukt att söka tjänsten i ett första steg så kommer ansvarig rekryterare ta kontakt med dig om du har en matchande profil för tjänsten. Alla ansökningar och kontakter behandlas konfidentiellt. Active Search får inte längre ta emot eller hantera ansökningar som inkommer via mejl då detta strider mot direktiven i GDPR. För att din ansökan ska behandlas måste du skicka in din ansökan via Ansök här i annonsen.

jobs.title: Environmental Engineering / Hydrogeology Specialist
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29258

Category: Engineering - Planning / Environmental

Job Type: Full-time

The Generation Engineering (GE) Planning & Environmental (P&E) Group is seeking a senior environmental engineer / contaminated land specialist to join the Environmental Engineering Team. The primary responsibility of the role will be managing and delivering services and solutions related to land remediation, pollution control and waste management across the Generation and Trading (GT) project portfolio. The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert in land remediation and hydrogeology, leading environmental site investigations, risk assessments and remediation programmes, while ensuring compliance with environmental legislation, regulatory requirements and industry best practice.

Through specialist expertise in contaminated land, groundwater protection, environmental risk assessment and remediation, the successful candidate will help deliver resilient low-carbon infrastructure while protecting the environment, managing risk and supporting ESB's commitment to environmental excellence and sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage environmental site investigations, assessments and hydrogeological studies for development, operational and demolition/decommissioning projects.

* Procure and manage external consultants and contractors, review technical reports, and provide expert recommendations to project teams and senior management in relation to Conceptual Site Models (CSMs), Generic Quantitative Risk Assessments (GQRA), Detailed Quantitative Risk Assessments (DQRA) and Remedial Options Appraisals.Manage existing and/or new contract frameworks with relevant industry specialist contractors.

* Assess groundwater quality data and identify potential impacts to controlled waters, water supplies, ecosystems and sensitive receptors.

* Provide specialist advice on contaminated land management, land remediation, resource and waste management, and regulatory compliance.

* Manage environmental incident investigations involving land, groundwater or surface water contamination events.

* Undertake environmental compliance activities, including construction site environmental compliance and resource and waste management audits, for ESB construction projects.

* Contribute to the continual improvement of environmental management systems, technical standards and guidance documents.

**Experience and Qualifications**

**Essential**

* A minimum of 7 years of relevant experience within the area of environmental management / environmental compliance / programme management or equivalent

* Level 8 Environmental Engineering/Science Degree or equivalent qualification

* Demonstrated experience in contaminated land with exposure to a wide range of environmental and engineering situations including:

* Knowledge of and successful delivery of projects in accordance with the following: EPA Guidance on Contaminated Land and Groundwater at EPA licenced sites, 2013 & Environment Agency Land Contamination and Risk Management (LCRM) 2020; Guidance on the classification and assessment of waste (1st edition v1.1, WM3) & BS 10175:2011 + A2:2017 Investigation of potentially contaminated sites.

* Knowledge of and experience in soil and waste management, waste classification, hydrogeological assessment, due diligence, Licensing and Permitting, Generic Quantitative Risk Assessments (GQRA’s), Detailed Quantitative Risk Assessments (DQRA’s) and Remedial Options Appraisals.

* Working knowledge of Irish and EU environmental legislation and industry best practice standards /guidelines required.

* Experience with working in multi-disciplinary teams and delivering small to large scale projects.

* Strong project management skills, including excellent communication, collaboration and report writing skills.

* Full driving licence and access to a car.

**Desirable**

* Project management qualification

* Level 9 Environmental Engineering/Science Degree or equivalent qualification

* Chartership within a relevant professional institution / body.

**Location**

The successful candidates may be based in either:

* E&MP Offices, The Sidings Building, Dublin 2
* E&MP Offices, Eastgate, Little Island, Cork

Travel to project locations as required, is a key requirement of the role.

Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

**Reporting To**

Environmental Engineering Senior Team Lead in the Gen Eng Planning & Environmental Group.

  

**Why Work with Us?**

* Opportunity to lead Ireland's transition to a net-zero carbon future
* Career development through mentoring and training
* Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities
* Sports and Social Clubs
* Networking opportunities
* Credit Union
* Generous Pension
* Access to staff wellbeing programmes
* Generous parental leave entitlements
* Strong values-based and inclusive culture
* Strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
* Great team environment working to our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted
  

**Salary**

€59,000 - €70,000 per annum

  

**Closing Date**

21st October 2026

  

**Interview**

Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:

* Accountable and Ethical
* Collaborative
* Growing and Adaptive
* Proactive
* Respectful and Supportive
  

More information available on Our People Promise

  

**Notes**

Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.

The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**

ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.

Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.

Join us in our mission to achieve a net-zero electricity system by 2040. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero-carbon electricity.

jobs.title: Onshore Cable Specialist Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29257

Category: Engineering - Civil / Structural

Job Type: Full-time

The Generation Engineering Delivery department in ESB Engineering and Major Projects leads engineering support for ESB’s generation business. The Generation Cables department is responsible for the design and project management of high voltage underground grid cable connections for large scale thermal and renewable generation projects including offshore wind projects

This role will act as the lead engineering authority for the onshore underground section of the export cable system connecting major ESB and JV offshore wind farms in Ireland and the UK to the onshore grid. Active projects include Oriel and Five Estuaries. This role covers the full lifecycle of the onshore cable route - from early design and consenting through construction, commissioning, and handover into operations. You will ensure that all underground high‑voltage (HV) cable engineering activities meet project requirements, industry standards, and regulatory obligations while optimising safety, reliability, constructability, and long‑term asset performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership: Lead the design, specification, and engineering assurance of the underground HV export cable system including cable selection, thermal rating, jointing, terminations, and civil works interfaces.

* Route Engineering & Civil Interface: Oversee development of the onshore cable route, including trench design, ducting, crossings, HDD sections, landfall interfaces, and coordination with civil engineering teams.

* Standards & Compliance: Ensure all engineering deliverables comply with relevant standards (e.g. IEC, CIGRE) and statutory requirements. Provide expert guidance on all aspects of cable system design, rating, earthing and bonding.

* Supplier & Contractor Management: Lead technical engagement with cable manufacturers, installation contractors, and specialist consultants. Review and approve technical documentation, method statements, FAT/SAT procedures, and installation quality plans.

* Construction & Installation Support: Provide senior engineering oversight during trenching, duct installation, cable pulling, jointing, testing, and commissioning. Resolve technical issues on site and ensure adherence to safety and quality standards.

* Risk & Interface Management: Identify and manage technical risks across interfaces with offshore cable systems, substations, grid connection points, and civil works. Ensure seamless integration of the onshore section with the overall export system.

* Asset Performance & Lifecycle Considerations: Contribute to long‑term reliability planning, including thermal performance modelling, failure mode analysis, maintenance strategies, and operational constraints.

* Safety to have highest priority in all aspects of work.

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

**Essential**

* Extensive experience (typically 7+ years) in HV underground cable engineering for transmission or large‑scale renewable projects.

* Strong understanding of cable system design, installation techniques, thermal modelling, interface management, HV testing and commissioning.

* A good knowledge of standards applicable to HV Cables (e.g. IEC, CIGRE)

* Ability to work on own initiative, meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.

* A flexible approach to work and strong ability to prioritise work.

* Good interpersonal, problem solving, communication and technical report writing skills.

* A strong work ethic with a clear focus on delivery to ESB’s’ Net Zero by 2040 Strategy’

* Strong commercial, project management and design review capability.

* Hold a full driving licence and have own car.

**Desirable**

* Chartered Engineer Status

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

Degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.

**Desirable**

Active involvement in international engineering organisations such as CIGRE, IEEE and IET (e.g. participation in Working Groups)

**Location**

The position will be based in ESB Engineering & Major Projects’ offices at The Sidings, Grand Canal Quay, Dublin 2, D02 E7K8.

Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

**Reporting to**

20th October 2026

jobs.title: Research Engineer (1-year contract or till 14 Jan 2028), SCIS
jobs.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION
  
  
Singapore Management University is a place where high-level professionalism blends together with a healthy informality. The 'family-like' atmosphere among the SMU community fosters a culture where employees work, plan, organise and play together - building a strong collegiality and morale within the university.
  
  
Our commitment to attract and retain talent is ongoing. We offer attractive benefits and welfare, competitive compensation packages, and generous professional development opportunities - all to meet the work-life needs of our staff. No wonder, then, that SMU continues to be given numerous awards and recognition for its human resource excellence.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
This position is for School of Computing and Information Systems (SCIS).
  
  
Extend and maintain the lab's VR testbed (Unity front-end, Python back-end) integrating live speech recognition, eye tracking, hand tracking, and a scene-graph representation of the task environment.
  
  
Implement an incremental multimodal reference resolver that fuses speech, gaze, and gesture into a continuously-updated belief distribution over candidate interpretations, meeting real-time latency requirements (less than 200ms end to end).
  
  
Design and implement a library of in-situ visual overlays that render the agent's belief in VR, and integrate them with the communication policy developed by the Co-PI's team.
  
  
Design, pilot, and run controlled lab user studies (between- and within-subjects, N≈24-48), including experiment scripting, instrumentation and logging of behavioural measures, participant recruitment and scheduling, and IRB documentation.
  
  
Analyse quantitative (ANOVA, trust-calibration and error measures) and qualitative (interview, think-aloud) study data, and co-author submissions to CHI, UIST, DIS, CSCW, or HRI.
  
  
Collect, annotate, and release an expanded public corpus of natural deictic instructions, including running elicitation sessions and maintaining the annotation scheme and documentation.
  
  
Other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
Minimum Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or closely related disciplines from a reputable institution of higher learning; with particular focus on Human-Robot Interaction.
  
  
Minimum 1 year of relevant research experience in Human-Robot Interaction as a graduate student, research assistant or research engineer.
  
  
Proficiency in programming software/languages such as C# and Python, and the Unity environment is required.
  
  
Hands-on experience developing for VR head-mounted displays (e.g., Meta Quest, OpenXR), including eye- and hand-tracking input.
  
  
Experience integrating real-time multimodal input pipelines (speech recognition, gaze, gesture) and/or LLM/VLM APIs into interactive systems.
  
  
Proven track record and professional experience in interface prototyping, user experimental design.
  
  
Demonstrated experience and know-how on academic research, literature survey, and academic manuscript preparation.
  
  
Technical skills in designing robotic interaction techniques, driving robotic simulation studies, or robotic prototypes with novel interaction techniques for human-robot interaction.
  
  
Technical skills with respect to user research design, and statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.
  
  
Ability to break down complex problems and design effective solutions.
  
  
Innovating new approaches and thinking outside the box.
  
  
Applicants with research publications in the HCI or HRI area will be advantageous.
  
  
Ability to work cooperatively as part of a small, agile academic research team is essential.
  
  
Self-motivated individual who can work independently and collaboratively with team members.
  
  
OTHER INFORMATION
